criteria.text: Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $134,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $133,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the Foxley Logistics plc contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Lists the Foxley Logistics plc change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
